responsibility: Implements the generic core of GCC’s Haifa RTL instruction scheduler: per-insn scheduler state, logical UID management, ready-list handling, priority-driven list scheduling mechanics, and target hook integration for issue/dispatch decisions. It operates on dependency graphs built elsewhere, maintains scheduler-visible metadata such as costs, ticks, queue positions, speculation state, and register-pressure annotations, updates emitted-insn bookkeeping during scheduling transformations, and provides common block/insn manipulation helpers used by region, EBB, and related scheduling front ends.
